chunks: My father narrated to us, may God be pleased with him, saying: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ali ibn al-Salt narrated to me, on the authority of Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Hammad ibn Isa, on the authority of Rubay ibn Abdullah, on the authority of Fuzayl ibn Yasar, on the authority of Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
If a man loves his religion, his brethren will love him.
ai.seo_question: Why do people love someone who is devoted to their religion?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to illustrate how internal spiritual conviction (*hubb al-din*) naturally manifests as social cohesion, ensuring that one's piety is recognized and cherished by the community. This reflects the Shia concept of *wilayah* extending beyond theological allegiance to include interpersonal bonds, where shared religious love fosters mutual respect and unity among believers.
